M-029: Risk assessment – site-wide review completed. The consolidated risk assessment for the festival site was reviewed and approved by the Safety Committee on 2026-03-02 at 14:00. The assessment covers the main stage area, discovery stage, artist village, food and beverage zones, and the east residential buffer. Key controls include a 2.5 m crowd barrier setback from the main stage, a 10 km/h vehicle speed limit within the service lanes, and a dedicated medical point staffed from 12:00 to 23:00 on both festival days. The document is now the controlling reference for all site safety matters. A copy has been lodged with the relevant authorities as required.

M-030: Security plan – draft submitted for approval. The draft security plan was submitted to the Festival Director on 2026-03-03 at 10:30. The plan includes a 24-hour security presence from 2026-03-09, a ratio of one security officer per 250 attendees at peak times, and a central control room equipped with CCTV covering all entry points and the main thoroughfares. The plan also details the bag check protocol and the coordination procedure with the Singapore Police Force for the event days. Please note that the plan is currently pending approval; the Safety Committee will review it on 2026-03-06. Any comments or required changes are to be submitted by 17:00 on 2026-03-05.

M-031: Perimeter fencing – installation in progress. The installation of the perimeter fencing began on 2026-03-03 and is scheduled for completion by 18:00 on 2026-03-05. The fencing covers the full perimeter of the festival site, with a total length of 1,200 m. The main entrance gates are being fitted with ticket scanning infrastructure in parallel. The contractor has confirmed that the work is on track and that the east side fencing, which borders the residential area, will be completed first to ensure noise and access control from that direction.

M-032: Technical installations – power distribution complete. The primary power distribution network for the festival site was energised and tested on 2026-03-04 at 11:00. The network comprises four 400 A feeders serving the main stage, discovery stage, artist village, and the food and beverage zone. All distribution boards have been labelled and lockable. The backup generator set, rated at 500 kVA, has been installed and will undergo its load test on 2026-03-06. The audio and lighting teams have confirmed that the power supply meets the specifications for the calibrated systems.

M-033: Artist rehearsal slots (day 1) – schedule confirmed. The finalised rehearsal schedule for day 1 was circulated on 2026-03-08 at 09:00 as planned. The schedule allocates 30-minute slots for each main stage act, with a 60-minute slot for the headline act. Rehearsals begin at 09:00 on 2026-03-11 and conclude by 18:00. All artist management teams have acknowledged receipt of the schedule. The stage management team will be in place from 08:00 on 2026-03-11 to receive artists and coordinate the changeovers.

M-034: Sound & light calibration – completed ahead of schedule. The sound and light system calibration window, scheduled for 2026-03-05, was completed on 2026-03-04 at 16:30. The audio system has been tuned to the festival's noise level requirements, with specific attention to the residential area to the east of the site. The lighting rig is now fully installed, and all fixtures have been tested. A final verification of the noise monitoring system will be carried out on 2026-03-07.

**M-035: Festival days 1 & 2 – execution.**
Festival days 1 and 2 were executed on 2026-03-14 and 2026-03-15 as planned. Both days ran from 14:00 to 23:00, with the main stage programme completing on time each day. Day 1 attendance was 22,400 and day 2 attendance was 24,100, against a combined licensed capacity of 25,000 per day. No major incidents were reported. The artist village operated without disruption, and all scheduled acts performed. The east side noise monitoring stations recorded readings within the permitted limits on both days. Status: completed.

**M-036: Site restoration – contractor appointed.**
The site restoration contract was awarded on 2026-03-16 to the same fencing and infrastructure contractor who handled the build. The scope includes removal of temporary fencing, demounting of the main stage and discovery stage structures, clearing of the food and beverage zone, and reinstatement of the grass surface. Restoration work commenced on 2026-03-17 and is scheduled to complete by 2026-03-25. The contractor has confirmed that the east side fencing, which borders the residential area, will be removed last to maintain noise and access control until the rest of the site is cleared. Status: on track.

**M-037: Vendor settlement – first tranche.**
The first tranche of vendor payments was processed on 2026-03-20. This covers all food and beverage vendors, merchandise stalls, and the water refill station operators. Payment was made via GIRO against submitted invoices and settlement reports. A total of 47 vendors were paid. The second tranche, covering technical suppliers and the staging contractor, is scheduled for 2026-03-27. Status: completed.

**M-038: Lost and found – closure.**
The lost and found operation, run from the festival office, was closed on 2026-03-22. A total of 183 items were logged. Of these, 141 items were returned to owners during the festival and the post-event collection window. The remaining 42 items, including 8 items that were unclaimed after the 7-day retention period, were donated to a local charity on 2026-03-22. All claimants were verified against the item log and proof of purchase where applicable. Status: completed.

**M-039: Debrief session – internal team.**
The internal debrief session was held on 2026-03-24 from 10:00 to 12:30 at the festival office. Attendees included the festival director, production manager, stage managers, head of security, and leads from the volunteer coordination and sustainability teams. Key discussion points were the crowd flow at the main entrance gates during the first hour of day 1, the performance of the new ticket scanning infrastructure, and the coordination of artist changeovers on the discovery stage. Action items from the session were logged in the post-event action tracker and are due for review at the post-event review meeting. Status: completed.

**M-040: Sustainability report – draft submitted.**
The draft sustainability report was submitted by the sustainability lead on 2026-03-26. The report covers waste diversion rates, water usage, and the performance of the free water refill stations. Initial figures indicate a waste diversion rate of 68%, against a target of 70%. The draft also includes a breakdown of the single-use cup take-up and the return rate for the cup deposit scheme. The final report is due by 2026-04-08 after incorporating comments from the festival director. Status: on track.

Backstage containers removed from site. Production office container and dressing room

**M-035: Festival days 1 & 2 – execution.**
Festival days 1 and 2 were executed on 2026-03-14 and 2026-03-15 as planned. Both days ran from 14:00 to 23:00, with the main stage programme completing on time each day. Day 1 attendance was 22,400 and day 2 attendance was 24,100, against a combined licensed capacity of 25,000 per day. No major incidents were reported. Status: completed.

**M-036: Site restoration – contractor appointed.**
The site restoration contract was awarded on 2026-03-16 to the same fencing and infrastructure contractor who handled the build. The scope includes removal of temporary fencing, demounting of the main stage and discovery stage structures, clearing of the food and beverage zone, and reinstatement of the grass surface. Restoration work commenced on 2026-03-17 and is scheduled to complete by 2026-03-25. The contractor has confirmed that the east side fencing, which borders the residential area, will be removed last to maintain noise and access control until the rest of the site is cleared. Status: on track.

The first tranche of vendor payments was processed on 2026-03-20. This covers all food and beverage vendors, merchandise stalls, and the water refill station operators. Payment was made via GIRO against submitted invoices and settlement reports. A total of 47 vendors were paid. The second tranche, covering technical suppliers and the staging contractor, is scheduled for 2026-03-27. Status: completed.

The lost and found operation, run from the festival office, was closed on 2026-03-22. A total of 183 items were logged. The remaining 42 items, including 8 items that were unclaimed after the 7-day retention period, were donated to a local charity on 2026-03-22. The internal debrief session was held on 2026-03-24 from 10:00 to 12:30 at the festival office. Attendees included the festival director, production manager, stage managers, head of security, and leads from the volunteer coordination and sustainability teams. Key discussion points were the crowd flow at the main entrance gates during the first hour of day 1, the performance of the new ticket scanning infrastructure, and the coordination of artist changeovers on the discovery stage. The draft sustainability report was submitted by the sustainability lead on 2026-03-26. The report covers waste diversion rates, water usage, and the performance of the free water refill stations. Initial figures indicate a waste diversion rate of 68%, against a target of 70%. The draft also includes a breakdown of the single-use cup take-up and the return rate for the cup deposit scheme. The final report is due by 2026-04-08 after incorporating comments from the festival director. Status: on track.

documents.title: Construction and Site Logs – Marina Bay Floating Platform
documents.content:
2026-02-06 (Fri)
Decking 100% complete. Surface sweep and level check done. Minor shimming required at four points near the stage front; corrected before sign-off. Structural inspection of sub-floor passed by appointed engineer (R. Tan, PE). Lumen Stageworks to begin wing tower assembly Monday.

2026-02-07 (Sat)
No works scheduled. Site secured; guard patrol in place.

2026-02-08 (Sun)
No works scheduled.

2026-02-09 (Mon)
Wing tower (stage left) assembly started. Crane lift plan reviewed and approved. Base plates grouted by 14:00. Tower sections lifted and bolted; 30% complete by end of day. Wind speed within limits all day.

2026-02-10 (Tue)
Wing tower (stage left) 80% complete. Tower (stage right) assembly started. Bolted connections torqued and marked. No safety incidents.

2026-02-11 (Wed)
Wing towers both 100% complete. Diagonal bracing installed. Tower plumbness checked with theodolite; within tolerance. Roof truss sections delivered on site at 11:00 and staged on the deck. Lumen Stageworks to start truss assembly tomorrow.

2026-02-12 (Thu)
Roof truss assembly began. Main truss sections lifted into position using two mobile cranes. 40% of truss spliced and bolted by end of day. Works paused at 17:30 for lightning risk; resumed 18:15. No damage.

2026-02-13 (Fri)
Truss 75% complete. Connection bolts verified by Lumen QC. Load cells installed on four suspension points. Hand signal team coordination good.

2026-02-14 (Sat)
Truss 100% complete. Roof membrane installation started; 50% done by 17:00. Crew worked through lunch to make up time. Membrane seams heat-welded and tested.

2026-02-15 (Sun)
Roof membrane 100% complete. Water test conducted – no leaks observed. Drip edge trim installed. Stage deck surface final sanding and sealing scheduled for next week.

Lumen Stageworks stage_construction_completed was 2026-03-10T18:00:00+08:00 per the construction logs. Record status: historical.

2026-02-16 (Mon)
Stage deck sealing started. First coat applied 09:00–13:00; second coat 14:00–17:30. Drying time 24 hours. Area cordoned off. No foot traffic permitted on deck until 18 Feb 09:00.

2026-02-17 (Tue)
Deck sealant curing. No works on deck. Crews focused on backstage cabinetry and equipment bays. Electrical sub-contractor (ACME Power) ran main feeder cables from venue distribution board to stage power distribution units. 70% of cable pull complete.

2026-02-18 (Wed)
Deck reopened at 09:00 after inspection. Surface finish acceptable. Cable pull 100% complete. Termination of feeders at PDU scheduled for 19 Feb. Lumen Stageworks to commence stage lift installation.

2026-02-19 (Thu)
Stage lift (centre section) installed. Hydraulic system pressure tested. Lift travel range verified: 0–1.5 m. Control panel interfacing with venue system confirmed. Safety interlocks checked. Lumen Stageworks crew to complete lift pit covers tomorrow.

2026-02-20 (Fri)
Lift pit covers installed and flush with deck. Walk test conducted. Stage lift certified for use by appointed engineer. PA system rigging points installed on truss. No issues.

2026-02-21 (Sat)
No works scheduled. Site secured.

2026-02-22 (Sun)
No works scheduled.

2026-02-23 (Mon)
Stage left and right stair towers delivered and installed. Handrails fitted. Non-slip nosing applied. Acoustic panels for back wall installed – 30% complete.

2026-02-24 (Tue)
Acoustic panels 100% complete. Stage front fascia panels installed. Lighting bars (front of house) rigged. Lumen Stageworks to begin final electrical terminations for stage lighting tomorrow.

documents.title: Construction and Site Logs – Marina Bay Floating Platform
documents.content:
2026-02-25 (Wed)
Final electrical terminations for stage lighting completed by 16:00. All circuits tested and tagged. Dimmer racks installed in equipment bay A. Control console positioned at FOH mix position. DMX runs verified end to end.

2026-02-26 (Thu)
Front of house lighting truss loaded with all fixtures. Focus and gobo alignment in progress. PA system line array flown on main truss. Subwoofer stacks placed on stage deck per acoustic plan. System tuning scheduled for 27 Feb.

2026-02-27 (Fri)
PA system tuning conducted 09:00–17:00. Pink noise and impulse response measurements taken at 12 positions across the venue. EQ adjustments applied. No significant resonances noted. SPL levels within target range. Lighting focus 70% complete.

2026-02-28 (Sat)
Lighting focus 100% complete. House lights tested. Emergency lighting and exit signs inspected – all functional. Backstage intercom system installed and tested. No issues.

2026-03-01 (Sun)
No works scheduled. Site secured.

2026-03-02 (Mon)
Site walkthrough with Safety Officer and Site Operations Manager. General housekeeping items identified – 3 minor items, all rectified same day. Stage deck swept and mopped. Backstage areas cleaned. Waste bins placed at designated points.

2026-03-03 (Tue)
Video wall installation commenced. Main LED screen panels delivered and rigged on rear truss. 40% of panels installed. Signal distribution cabling run from media server position to screen. Server rack set up in equipment bay B.

2026-03-04 (Wed)
Video wall 100% installed. Screen tested with test patterns – no dead pixels. Media server configured with show file. Preview monitors mounted at FOH and stage manager position. Camera platform constructed at rear of FOH mix position.

2026-03-05 (Thu)
Camera platform complete. 3 camera positions marked on deck. Cable ramps laid across walkways. All video and audio cables dressed and secured. Cable management inspected – acceptable.

2026-03-06 (Fri)
Production office set up in backstage container. Furniture and IT equipment installed. Wi-Fi access points tested throughout backstage and FOH areas. Printer and fax line verified. Production team moved in.

2026-03-07 (Sat)
Artist dressing rooms prepared. Furniture, mirrors, and lighting installed. Refreshment stations stocked. Air conditioning tested – all units operational. Room temperature stable at 22°C.

2026-03-08 (Sun)
No works scheduled.

2026-03-09 (Mon)
Green room and hospitality area completed. Catering counters installed. Water and beverage points connected. Waste management plan posted. First aid room set up with supplies and equipment. Medical team to confirm readiness tomorrow.

2026-03-10 (Tue)
Final walkthrough of all backstage areas with Site Operations Manager. All items checked and signed off. Medical team confirmed readiness. Security control room activated. Access control system tested – all gates and turnstiles functioning.

2026-03-11 (Wed)
Lighting and sound final rehearsal support. Full show playback run with all systems active. Lighting cues verified against script. Sound levels checked from multiple positions. Video playback synced with audio – no issues. All systems stable throughout.

2026-03-12 (Thu)
Final inspections conducted by building management and safety officer. Fire safety systems tested – alarms, sprinklers, extinguishers all verified. Emergency evacuation routes checked and clear. Electrical load test completed – within capacity. Inspection certificates issued.

2026-03-13 (Fri)
Final cleaning completed. All temporary structures inspected and certified. Site handover checklist signed by Site Operations Manager Jason Lee. The 2026 Aurora Bay Music Festival site_handover_completed was 2026-03-13T17:00:00+08:00 per the handover checklist. Record status: historical. Site formally handed over to festival production team at 17:00. Keys and access cards transferred. All contractors demobilised by 18:30. Site secured for event day.

documents.title: Construction and Site Logs – Marina Bay Floating Platform
documents.content:
2026-03-14 (Sat)

Post-handover inspection of public concourse and spectator zones completed. All barriers and
crowd-control measures in place. Signage installed per wayfinding plan. Verified that all
temporary fencing is secured and no gaps present. Portable toilets delivered and positioned at
all six designated points. Water points connected and tested. Cleaning crew completed final
sweep of the concourse at 16:30. No works scheduled for tomorrow.

2026-03-15 (Sun)

Event day support. Site operations team on standby from 08:00. All entry gates opened on
schedule. Assisted festival production with last-minute requests – additional barricades at the
main stage side, extra rubbish bins near the food village. No structural issues reported. All
temporary structures remained stable throughout the day. Site cleared and secured at 23:30.

2026-03-16 (Mon)

Post-event inspection commenced. Walked the entire site with festival production coordinator.
Checked all temporary structures for damage. Found minor scuff marks on two portable toilet
units – to be cleaned by supplier. No structural damage identified. Electrical distribution
panels inspected – all breakers in normal position. Lighting towers confirmed in good
condition. Water and drainage systems checked – no leaks detected. Full report to follow.

2026-03-17 (Tue)

Demobilisation of temporary structures began. Contractor teams mobilised at 09:00. Portable
toilets removed and cleaned off-site. Fencing contractor started removal of crowd barriers.
Stage and sound system demobilisation scheduled for Wednesday. Access control gates and
turnstiles removed and returned to storage. Security control room decommissioned. All site
access points now open.

2026-03-18 (Wed)

Stage and sound system demobilisation completed. Main stage structure dismantled without
incident. Sound towers lowered and loaded for transport. Lighting rig removed and packed.
Video screens taken down and crated. All equipment checked against inventory list before
departure – no discrepancies. Backstage containers scheduled for removal tomorrow.

2026-03-19 (Thu)

Backstage containers removed from site. Production office container and dressing room
containers collected by supplier. Green room and hospitality area cleared of all furniture
and fixtures. First aid room cleaned and restocked – supplies transferred to festival
storage. Catering counters dismantled. Site returned to original configuration. Final
inspection of the entire platform conducted – no debris or waste left behind. All areas
swept and clean.

2026-03-20 (Fri)

Final demobilisation report issued. All temporary structures removed, all equipment
returned, all waste disposed of. Site handed back to Marina Bay Floating Platform management
at 15:00. Handover checklist signed by Jason Lee and building management representative.
No outstanding items. This concludes the construction and site log for the 2026 Aurora Bay
Music Festival.
